nodes.title: Almost all orbits reach almost bounded values
nodes.author: Terence Tao
nodes.summary: For every function f(N) tending to infinity, the orbit minimum is below f(N) for almost every start in logarithmic density. This does not establish convergence to 1 for every start.

nodes.title: Stabilisation of first passage
nodes.author: Terence Tao
nodes.summary: A first-passage stabilisation estimate is a central reduction in Tao’s argument. The statement concerns the distributions specified in the paper.

nodes.title: Fine-scale 3-adic mixing
nodes.author: Terence Tao
nodes.summary: The argument estimates a Syracuse offset distribution on powers of three through Fourier decay. This is a probabilistic estimate, not independence of every integer orbit.

nodes.title: Renewal process and Fourier decay
nodes.author: Terence Tao
nodes.summary: A two-dimensional renewal process is used to control the high-frequency estimates that feed the mixing argument.

nodes.title: Almost-everywhere descent below the start
nodes.author: Riho Terras
nodes.summary: A density-one stopping-time result. Almost all starts descending below themselves does not eliminate every exceptional starting value.

nodes.title: Independent almost-everywhere descent
nodes.author: C. J. Everett
nodes.summary: An independent result on descent below the starting value. The map must retain the distinction between almost all integers and every integer.

nodes.title: The 3x+1 conjugacy map
nodes.author: Daniel J. Bernstein & Jeffrey C. Lagarias
nodes.summary: An exact 2-adic coding of the dynamics. A structural representation of all codes does not prove convergence of every positive integer.

nodes.title: The 3x+1 problem and its generalizations
nodes.author: Jeffrey C. Lagarias
nodes.summary: A survey supplying historical and mathematical context. This entry is background, not a new solution or an attribution of project results to Lagarias.

nodes.title: Weighted fibers: a smaller remaining core
nodes.author: Khamit Kadyrbekov & Daniyal Kadirbekov · project record
nodes.summary: A manually checked finite-cutoff estimate bounds the routed mass by a primitive term plus half of the weighted total. The remaining core is not proved finite.

nodes.title: Use the first birth to reduce the core
nodes.author: Khamit Kadyrbekov & Daniyal Kadirbekov · project record
nodes.summary: A new draft charges some later primitive fibers to a first source already in the complementary mass. The full argument and its audits remain separate from a Collatz proof.
